Business reason: a timing-dependent unit test ejects unrelated PRs from the merge queue at random, and each ejection rebuilds the entries behind it.

## 维护者速读

一个退出登录相关的界面单测有时序竞态：它断言“列表状态已保存”，可这个保存要么由防抖触发、要么在退出时 flush 触发，测试没等到其中任何一个就断言了。今天合并队列里因此误踢了一个无关的 PR。改成确定地触发 flush（或用假计时器推进），不要靠真实时间。

## Reading

```
FAIL  dom  packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx
  > sign-out clears the signed-out user's list state and list filters
  > signOut() removes every list-state and list-filters key and keeps the sign-in page language   353ms
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called at least once
 ❯ expectServerRowsKept  signOutPurge.test.tsx:148:23   expect(family.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
   (comment at :147: "Sent by its debounce or by the flush when the user goes")
 ❯ signOutPurge.test.tsx:183:5
```

## What to build

1. Make the save deterministic in the test. Either drive the flush the sign-out path guarantees (await it explicitly), or use fake timers and advance past the debounce before asserting. Never wait on wall time.
2. If the product path can really leave the save unsent at sign-out, that is a product bug: fix it, and pin it here.
3. ⛔ Do not skip, retry-wrap or quarantine the case.

Grade: p2. It is a queue flake tax.
